question: Predict RNA secondary structures for the small RNAs in the provided FASTA file using ViennaRNA. Generate SVG images of the structures and report the dot-bracket notation with minimum free energies.

expected_output.guidelines: Structure must match the reference base-pair connectivity; visual styling and layout may differ.
Dot-bracket notation must exactly match the reference; MFE values must match within 1% relative absolute error; whitespace formatting may differ.
